title: The relocalization square of ringed topoi: a morphism of ringed topoi relocalizes along a morphism of sheaves
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file sites-modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a morphism of ringed topoi f : (Sh(C), O) -> (Sh(D), O') and a sheaf G on D, setting F = f^{-1}G produces a commutative square of ringed topoi whose vertical arrow is the relocalized morphism f' and whose horizontal arrows are the localization morphisms, together with the identity f'_* j_F^{-1} = j_G^{-1} f_* and the description of (f')^{-1}. The proof takes the diagram of underlying topoi and both identities from the corresponding sites lemma, then defines the structure map (f')^sharp as the composite j_G^{-1} O' -> j_G^{-1} f_* O = f'_* j_F^{-1} O = f'_* O_F, or equivalently by the adjoint description, and verifies that the resulting data make the square commute in ringed topoi (proof lines 2954-2990). H2: the construction of the structure map and the verification of the square are the substance.
